scopeCorrection.reason: Actual checker excludes Tests and .gitattributes from production_set; overcoverage is rejected. No candidate files are dropped.

currentSummaryCorrections.before: Four derived results concern the same initial-half, strict-past squared-loss FTL predictor. For any all-time unit-valued stream, finite nonpositive regret limits at every fixed unit comparator are equivalent to convergence of its empirical means. A fixed deterministic dyadic stream lies in [0,1] and has two distinct empirical-mean subsequential limits. For this stream, upper-epsilon no-regret and normalized interval-best regret tending to zero coexist with no finite ordinary limit at fixed comparator zero. This is an obstruction for this specific process, not an impossibility result for all algorithms. Source text and any proposed source correction remain separate; no repair approval is inferred. The original sixteen Chapter 1 source objects and unknown required proof total are retained. Remaining Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 obligations, unenumerated Chapters 3–16 and required appendices remain separate; no chapter or book completion is established.
